en: Sepia-toned early 20th‑century photograph showing a formal horse‑drawn carriage in front of an ornate palace or grand residence. A uniformed coachman drives two horses, while richly dressed dignitaries or royals sit in the open carriage, including a woman in a large hat and a man in full military uniform with decorations. The building behind has a columned entrance with a balcony above, decorative garlands, and elaborate street lamps, suggesting a ceremonial occasion.
